summary: Fourth consolidated daily run. News sweep of 2026-10-22 to 2026-10-23 (Federal Register API for rules, proposed rules and presidential documents, the whitehouse.gov presidential actions page, the Supreme Court orders pages, and checks on 27 watch items): four official developments were mapped and added after independent review, none changing a stage. An executive order of 2026-10-22 on housing costs created a Task Force on Manufactured Housing Innovation that is to evaluate conditioning federal grants on standardized local permitting (c15-13); a Section 232 proclamation of 2026-10-22 on wind turbines directed negotiations and set no new duty (c26-04); a Defense Production Act section 303 determination of 2026-10-22 covered domestic petroleum production, refining and logistics capacity (c00-15, a Foreword record, listed but not counted); and the OCC published its final GENIUS Act stablecoin rule on 2026-10-23 (91 FR 67000, effective 2027-01-18), kept as a parallel event on c22-23. A Treasury proposed rule of 2026-10-23 implementing the institutional-investor purchase restriction of the 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act and an NRC docketing notice for a private petition on reprocessing plants bear on no tracked recommendation. The watch items showed no new court or legislative action (H.R. 5235 still unpresented, H.R. 5349 without House action, no CY 2027 OPPS final rule, no BIS affiliates-rule extension, no ESG fiduciary proposal, no decisions in the pending D.C. Circuit, First Circuit and Third Circuit matters). Rotation: six freshness checks (c02-16, c02-20, c05-21 and c28-06 gained evidence and were independently reviewed with no stage change; c04-23 and c05-20 checked without change) and four refutation checks on records counted as in effect (c06-16 weakened by a pending 25-state Court of International Trade challenge to the Section 301 duties, stage held; c06-17, c21-10 and c09-10 hold; c21-10 progress 65 to 70 after the 2026 Baldrige award cycle was confirmed as run by the partners). Review removed older non-action timeline entries from c28-06, c06-17, c09-10 and c26-04 and kept them in uncertainties. No stage changed; counts unchanged at 627. No pending requests; the three pending leads on dhs.gov and media.defense.gov still refuse fetches. About 37 of 120 searches used. Export to GitHub paused.
